captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a rectangular open-top storage box. The box has solid vertical walls and a solid bottom plate, featuring four thin circular helper disks (anti-warping pads) attached to the bottom four corners. The design is simple, robust, and clean, optimized for easy 3D printing.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable open-top rectangular box in OpenSCAD with options to prevent warping. Key parameters should include overall dimensions (box_x, box_y, box_z), wall thickness, and adjustable helper pads at the bottom corners defined by pad_height and pad_radius.
captions.factory: The script constructs the box using a modular approach. A 'padded_cube' module creates the base block using a cube primitive combined with cylinders at the corners for anti-warping pads. The 'side' module utilizes difference operations to hollow out the center of a side frame, while the final assembly rotates and translates three side panels (bottom, front, back) to form the open-top box structure.
